description: This file implements a facade for logging configuration using logback, providing methods to set and retrieve logger configurations within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: LogbackLoggingFacade
classes.description: Implementation of the LoggingFacade interface using logback to manage logging levels

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of LogbackLoggingFacade

methods.name: setLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the log level for a specified logger based on provided LoggerConfig

methods.name: getLoggerConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the current logger configurations for all loggers

methods.name: getLoggerConfig (overload)
methods.description: Retrieves logger configurations for a provided list of logger names
